verdict.rationale: A SaaS agent platform could plausibly offer headless or CI-driven operation, such as running simulations from a pipeline, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes UI-driven tools (AOPs, Duet, Simulations, Experiments) and says nothing about a CLI, API-triggered runs, or CI integration. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every path, so nothing shows the product running headlessly.
